turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes before a client call, so let's start with Owen's zero. Who decided on it, and did anyone speak to him first?
I appreciate you coming in with an open mind.

My mind is open to documents, not to pleasantries. Your own procedure, 4.2, says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Owen found out on his phone, in the middle of a class.
A lot of parents in your position would have gone straight to the principal. You didn't. That says a lot about you.
Don't manage me. I haven't ruled out the principal's office, and I'll be going there next if this goes nowhere. What do you have on Owen's essay?
So I'd like to keep this between us and keep it friendly. Deal?
Nothing here is between us, Hale. Anything agreed goes in writing, and I'm not promising to stay friendly or quiet before I've seen a single document. What do you have?
